FIT GUIDANCE

A better fit starts with facts.

Use actual garment measurements rather than assumptions from photos. A generic chart cannot guarantee bra cup or garment fit.

01 · MEASURE

Use a soft measuring tape

Measure over light clothing and keep the tape level without pulling it tight.

02 · VERIFY

Check each garment chart

Material, stretch and construction affect fit. Compare with the seller’s product-specific size chart before purchase.
